equipment: Gym Mats: 4 total (2 per side to build the Towers)
Big Traffic Cones: 4 total (used as the Pillars)
Agility Pads: Multiple (needed to block the balls on the 4 pillars, plus extras to create the "valley" track for the bowling balls)
Chairs: 2 total (one for each team to act as the "Throne")
Hula Hoops: 2 total (one to hang on each basketball rim)
Wall Scythes: 2 total (one attached to each Tower)
Target Balls: 4 total (to rest on top of the 4 Pillar cones)
Assorted Throwing Balls: A large amount (Dodgeballs, Foam Balls, or Smoosh Balls). You will need these for:
rules: 🏰 Game Setup & Equipment
The Moat: The area between the back volleyball line and the baseline.
Towers: Form a square using 4 mats (2 on each side). Place them outside of where the block and back volleyball line meet.
Pillars: 4 Big Traffic Cones placed on "corner 3" / baseline. Place a ball on top of each, and use Agility Pads to block the balls.
The Throne: Place a chair behind the rim on the baseline (behind the moat line).
Hula Hoop: Place one on the basketball rim.
Bowling Ball "Valley": Set up a bowling ball between agility pads. Place this out of bounds, between the basketball court sideline and the bleachers (an even distance from half-court for both teams).
🤺 Player Roles & Movement
Regular Players: Must stay on their own half of the court, strictly between the half-court line and the back volleyball line.
The Knight: One designated player per team.
Movement: The only player allowed to travel anywhere in the gym, including the opponent's side.
Restrictions: The Knight cannot complete any regular tasks. They are only allowed to knock over the Towers (Step 3) and complete the Final Move.
🚨 Jail & Penalties
Entering the Moat: If any regular player steps into the moat, they immediately go to jail.
To escape: They must catch a ball thrown to them by a teammate.
Bonus Penalty: Every time a team completes one of the "Side Quests" (see below), they get to choose one opponent to send to jail for 1 minute.
📜 The Main Quest (Sequential Tasks)
These tasks MUST be completed in this exact order to win the game:
Disarm: Remove the wall scythe from the Tower.
Fill the Towers: Throw 3 balls into each Tower.
Destroy the Towers: Once filled, the Knight gets to knock the Towers over (both towers can be destroyed at the same time, but both must be knocked over before moving on).
Clear the Pillars: Knock down the Agility Pads that are blocking the balls on the Pillars.
Strike the Pillars: Knock the balls off both Pillars.
The Final Move: The Knight must sit on the Throne and catch a ball thrown by their team.
🎯 Side Quests (Bonus Challenges)
These mandatory tasks can be completed at ANY time during the game, as long as they are done before the Knight attempts the Final Move.
The Bowling Ball Roll: Teams must get the bowling ball across the opposite side through the "valley" and into the moat (crossing the back volleyball line).
Rule: The bowling ball cannot be touched. It can only be moved by hitting it with a dodgeball, foam ball, or smoosh ball.
Knock the Halo: Knock the hula hoop off the basketball rim.
